scope: Four fresh Gazebo runs reduced from sealed saved arrays. No physics, control or estimator changes made by this analyzer.

fresh_baseline_vs_I40.scope: Same fresh baseline versus sealed I40 full saved double-precision arrays; no source-reproduction assumption.

window_convention: State observations include both endpoints. Held command intervals include lower/exclude upper endpoint and exclude overall terminal sample. Command jump at t includes preceding command even outside selected window.
numeric_precision: Geometry, commands, observer and state comparisons use precision.npz double arrays. Window lean uses saved float32 rollout attitude_error_rad; full-route metrics/gates use the original double-precision run summary.
limits: One deterministic run per arm; effect differences and interactions are descriptive, not statistical significance.
Truth shares are latest completed1ms force compared with interval-mean/filtered observer output; successful oracle is not a deployable controller.
Oracle changes feedback gain/support routing and retained held history, not records/normal/rolling FF/synchronizer inputs within that state.
Sync mask jointly removes preparatory command blending and nominal-reference increments, with private preview warm.
No default change or stability/robustness guarantee. Prefix equality and source manifests delimit the comparison.
